Name: EQUIP_PARAM_CUSTOM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Preset weapons with a fixed upgrade level and Ash of War. Used where a weapon slot or item entry is marked as a custom weapon: CharaInitParam weapon slots (Weapon Type = Custom Weapon), ItemLotParam items of category Custom Weapon and ShopLineupParam entries of equip type Custom Weapon. The weapon given is Base Weapon ID + Upgrade Level with this Ash of War attached.

Fields.Name: Base Weapon ID
Fields.Description: EquipParamWeapon row of the weapon at +0, including its affinity (e.g. 2000300 Quality Longsword). The final weapon ID is this plus Upgrade Level.

Fields.Name: Ash of War ID
Fields.Description: EquipParamGem row attached to the weapon. Below 0: none (retail also uses 0, which matches no gem row).

Fields.Name: Upgrade Level
Fields.Description: Upgrade level, added to Base Weapon ID to get the weapon row (+25 = base ID + 25).
